scope: Read-only policy input; no fitting, forecasts, simulator trials or tracked changes.

scope_separation.accuracy: Frozen v1 synthetic scaled RMSE caps and delayed-input probe; optional/declared historical reference guard. Exact flight mean/cache parity preserves already measured gains, not new untouched confirmation.
scope_separation.api: Public fit/predict/update signatures, contract/causality, serialization, recipe/format rejection, immutable revisions, ledger/dedup and bounded actual-N cache. Update mechanics are distinct from update improvement.
scope_separation.control: control-v5 and learned-controller-transfer qualify separate controller tasks. Neither is a mean-adoption prerequisite under model-first charter.
scope_separation.derivatives: JAX execution, causal Jacobian structure and numerical derivative checks establish software behavior, not physical derivative fidelity.
scope_separation.uncertainty: evidence-v2 measures coverage; report separately without vetoing new mean-adoption protocol. Keep calibration provenance truthful. historical harness.run/verify call with_evidence and cannot be used as an unlabeled mean-only acceptance flag.
scope_separation.updates: live-v3 tracks controller swapping and live improvement. Do not infer update improvement or real-time streaming safety from API semantics.

dataset.evaluation_origins: Every fifth row from row 2, keeping the origins that carry a complete consumed context and a complete forecast horizon.
dataset.initial_distribution: Uniform[-0.4,0.4] for every latent coordinate of the eight families in all regimes; Uniform[-1.5,1.5] for the witness.
dataset.purpose: Platform-neutral synthetic systems with known equations, carried forward verbatim from the M2 acceptance plan.

systems.delayed_nonlinear: x_next=.72*x+.22*tanh(2*u[k-4]); before k=4 the delayed input is zero.
systems.hidden_hysteresis: h_next=clip(h+.25*u,-.6,.6); x_next=.86*x+.18*h_next+.08*u. Only x is observed; h is latent.
systems.hidden_input_delay: x_next=.8*x+.2*u[k-3]; independent Uniform[-1,1] commands; before k=3 the delayed input is zero. Only x is observed.
systems.near_periodic: z_next=.98*R(2*pi/5.2)*z+.04*u; observe each coordinate as z+.35*z^3.
systems.noisy_observation: z_next=.92*z+.14*tanh(1.5*u)+.03*N(0,1); observe x=z+.04*N(0,1). Score observations, not latent state.
systems.off_periodic: Same warped observed oscillator with period 8.0 steps.

synthetic.dynamic_cache_requirement: 1536 is a public maximum, not a required count. Fixed synthetic records provide146 legal origins each; automatic6 training parents provide876 unique windows,2 development parents292 capped256. Keep data and timing exact; use actualN for full-cache gradients and ridge. Existing public input contract requires at least3 complete windows per role.

historical_reference.meaning: When the reference file exists beside this manifest, no case's overall scaled RMSE may exceed its reference value times 1.05 plus 0.005 in either regime. A run copies the reference it used into its output directory, so verify replays the same comparison.

information_budget.contract: The memory starts at rest at the first consumed observation, advances once per observed transition inside one recording segment, continues from predicted observations during the forecast, and composes exactly when carried within a recording. A forecast from rest consumes exactly context_steps + 1 observations; nothing earlier is implied.

synthetic.reference_scope: Historical accuracy regression allowance is additional to absolute caps. Preserve and report it explicitly; any prospective mean-adoption separation must be stated before new fits.
